raw_text: Complete blackout in parts of Assam since midnight. No electricity in Bongaigaon, Kokrajhar, and surrounding areas. Power department not responding. Other districts also reporting intermittent outages. Meghalaya and Tripura also affected. Government needs to explain what is happening to the power grid in the northeast.
clean_text: Complete blackout in parts of Assam including Bongaigaon and Kokrajhar. Intermittent outages across northeast including Meghalaya and Tripura.
